arStrings.szText: Summon a {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} when your Current Life drops below {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life. Enemies Taunted by {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} take {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage from you for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.
